title: Polish Jewelled Pilchard Gratin
description: A hearty and flavorful gratin dish featuring pilchards, jewel-toned vegetables, and a hint of herbal notes.

ingredients.name: jewelled vegetables (such as bell peppers, carrots, and green beans)
herbal butter (such as parsley and chives mixed with softened butter)
gratin cheese (such as cheddar or parmesan)

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine pilchards, jewelled vegetables, and herbal butter. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a separate bowl, mix polish rye flour and gratin cheese.
Transfer the pilchard mixture to a baking dish and top with the flour and cheese mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pilchards are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and chives if desired.
